name: Lazriel
source:
A girl who's lost her memories. Despite her circumstances, Lazriel remains bright, cheerful, and considerate of those around her.

(Description from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3466500/Putrika_1stcutThe_Reason_She_Must_Perish/]Steam[/url])
